definitions.explanation: The activity of climbing mountains, either as recreation or sport. Can range from hiking to technical climbing.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{登山|とざん}に{行|い}く{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: I plan to go mountain climbing this weekend.

examples.japanese: {富士山|ふじさん}{登山|とざん}は{夏|なつ}がベストシーズンだ。
examples.english: Summer is the best season for climbing Mt. Fuji.

examples.japanese: {登山|とざん}{客|きゃく}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of mountain climbers is increasing.

notes:
USAGE: {登山|とざん} is a general term for mountain climbing. Japan has a strong culture of mountain climbing, with many people climbing Mt. Fuji at least once.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{登山|とざん}する (to climb mountains)
・{登山|とざん}に{行|い}く (to go mountain climbing)
・{登山|とざん}{道|どう} (mountain trail)
・{登山|とざん}{靴|ぐつ} (hiking boots)
・{登山|とざん}{客|きゃく}/{登山|とざん}{者|しゃ} (climber)
・{登山|とざん}{口|ぐち} (trailhead)
・{登山|とざん}{届|とどけ} (climbing registration form)

RELATED WORDS:
・ハイキング (hiking - casual)
・トレッキング (trekking)
・{下山|げざん} (descending a mountain)
・{山登|やまのぼ}り (mountain climbing - casual)

CULTURAL NOTE: Climbing Mt. Fuji is a popular summer activity. The saying 「{一度|いちど}も{登|のぼ}らぬバカ、{二度|にど}{登|のぼ}るバカ」means 'A fool never climbs Fuji, but a bigger fool climbs it twice.'
